head: working-tree
subject: CONNECT-UDP capsule session caches incomplete capsule headers
change: The capsule session receive path previously attempted a full Capsule.parse for every stream fragment until a datagram's value bytes were complete. A 513-byte datagram split into 17-byte fragments therefore re-decoded the same capsule header about thirty times. capsule.parseHeader now exposes the type/length/header length, and pollBuffered/pollBufferedCapsule cache the expected total length for the incomplete capsule at the current receive offset. Subsequent fragments return null after a length comparison; the cache is keyed by receive offset and is ignored or cleared when the offset changes. A complete capsule is still parsed once before delivery.

benchmark.note: The host was loaded during this batch, so absolute times are higher than the quiet-host 239/284 ns baselines; only the interleaved ratios are claimed.

notes: The cache stores only the header length and value length, not a parsed slice, so it stays valid while the receive buffer grows. Control capsules interleaved with datagrams use the same cache through pollBufferedCapsule. The complete-capsule path still validates the type and value through Capsule.parse, and the existing incomplete-capsule bound checks are unchanged.
